question: Ano ang mga kailangang i-upload at magkano ang bayad para sa online business locational clearance sa CPDO?
answer:
Sa online application para sa Locational Clearance sa CPDO, ang kailangang i-upload ay:

1. Enforcement ng Integrated Zoning Ordinance (ZO) 2019 - 2028 sa Locational Clearance para sa negosyo (sa chunk DEV120-CPDO-PDF0070-C001). Hindi ma-i-specify sa source kung anong dokumento ang kailangang i-upload para sa online application.

Wala pa rin ma-i-specify sa mga ibang source kung anong bayad ang kailangan para sa online business locational clearance sa CPDO. Ang bayad para sa Mayor's Permit at service fee ay nakasaad sa chunks DEV120-BB-PDF0041-C001 at DEV120-BB-PDF0044-C001, ngunit wala pa rin ma-i-specify kung anong bayad ang kailangan para sa online application.

ground_truth: Under CPDO Service 12, Locational Clearance for Business (Online Application via appbts.davaocity.gov.ph) evaluates land-use compatibility under the Integrated ZO 2019-2028. Requirements uploaded to the portal are: 1) Filled-up application form; 2) Affidavit of Undertaking for neighbor's consent with sketch map; 3) Homeowners Association Certificate of No Objection (if inside a subdivision); 4) Proof of business working area pictures and road access; and 5) Certificate of Actual Land Occupancy (if inside ancestral land under RA 8371). There are no direct filing fees (None), and approval or issuance of a denial letter takes 1 Day and 50 Minutes.
